    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Customer
    Represents a customer entity in the system This class is mapped to a database table using JPA annotations.
    CustomerController
    Controller for handling customer-related API requests.
    CustomerRepository
    Repository for Customer entity operations.
    CustomerRequestDTO
    Represents the request body for creating a new customer.
    CustomerResponseDTO
    Represents customer data returned to the client.
    CustomerService
    Service class responsible for handling customer-related business logic.
    DataSeeder
    Seeds sample data into the database when the application starts.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Handles global application exceptions.
    Order
    Represents a order entity in the system This class is mapped to a database table using JPA annotations.
    OrderBST
    Represents a Binary Search Tree for storing Order objects based on their priority level.
    OrderBSTTest
    Unit tests for OrderBST.
    OrderController
    Controller for handling order-related API requests.
    OrderItem
    Represents an item in an order, including the product name, quantity, and price.
    OrderItemRepository
    Repository for OrderItem entity operations.
    OrderItemRequestDTO
    Represents the request body for creating or updating an order item.
    OrderItemResponseDTO
    Represents order item data returned to the client.
    OrderItemService
    Service class responsible for handling order item-related business logic.
    OrderNode
    Represents a node in the Order Binary Search Tree.
    OrderPriorityController
    Controller for handling BST priority-related order requests.
    OrderRepository
    Repository for Order entity operations.
    OrderRequestDTO
    Represents the request body for creating a new order.
    OrderResponseDTO
    Represents order data returned to the client.
    OrderService
    Service class responsible for handling order-related business logic.
    Product
    Represents a product entity in the system This class is mapped to a database table using JPA annotations.
    ProductController
    Controller for handling product-related API requests.
    ProductRepository
    Repository for Order entity operations.
    ProductRequestDTO
    Represents the request body for creating a new product.
    ProductResponseDTO
    Represents product data returned to the client.
    ProductService
    Service class responsible for handling business logic related to Products.
    ProductTest
    Unit tests for ProductSorter.
    RestServiceApplication
    Main application class for the RESTful service, responsible for bootstrapping the Spring Boot application.
